pages.quiz:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What do village elders do? (1 mark)
   A. Make cars
   B. Welcome visitors and help settle small quarrels
   C. Teach maths only
   D. Fly aeroplanes

2. What should you do if you are very angry? (1 mark)
   A. Hit someone
   B. Shout insults
   C. Break something
   D. Walk away and calm down

3. Which festival is held in Lamu? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi Snow Day
   B. Nakuru Fish Fair
   C. Lamu Cultural Festival
   D. Kisumu Rain Day

4. Why do some herding communities use portable dome-shaped houses? (1 mark)
   A. They can be moved when the family moves
   B. They cannot be moved
   C. They are very tall
   D. They are made of concrete

5. Why do farmers plan their work using seasons? (1 mark)
   A. Seasons decide school holidays only
   B. Seasons decide the colour of soil
   C. Crops need the right weather to grow and be harvested
   D. Seasons tell the price of clothes

6. What do clan elders do? (1 mark)
   A. Repair roads
   B. Sell tickets
   C. Keep customs and settle disputes
   D. Cook school lunch

7. A pupil faces the rising sun in the morning. Which direction is on the pupil's left hand? (1 mark)
   A. East
   B. South
   C. West
   D. North

8. Which of these is a democratic process in school? (1 mark)
   A. A bully choosing leaders
   B. Electing a class monitor by voting
   C. Punishing pupils who speak
   D. Ignoring pupils' ideas

9. Where does the sun rise? (1 mark)
   A. In the west
   B. In the east
   C. In the south
   D. In the north

10. Which activity involves growing crops and keeping animals? (1 mark)
   A. Fishing
   B. Mining
   C. Tourism
   D. Farming

11. Which is an effect of child abuse? (1 mark)
   A. Better health
   B. More friends
   C. Fear and lost education
   D. Higher marks

12. Where does a county government get money? (1 mark)
   A. Only from gifts
   B. Only from fines
   C. From the national government and local fees and taxes
   D. From nowhere

13. On a county sketch map, what does the north arrow show? (1 mark)
   A. The direction of north
   B. The number of people
   C. The size of the county
   D. The rainfall

14. Which of these is a way of participating in the Children's Government? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring elections
   B. Breaking rules
   C. Laughing at leaders
   D. Voting for leaders

15. What is a project? (1 mark)
   A. A kind of fruit
   B. A type of shoe
   C. A plan of work with a start, a finish and a goal
   D. A holiday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the four in-between points on a compass and say between which cardinal points each lies. (4 marks)

17. A group spent Ksh 350 on seeds and Ksh 150 on tools. They sold vegetables for Ksh 800. Find the profit. Show working. (3 marks)

18. Describe four steps to develop a good quality such as punctuality. (4 marks)

19. Describe how you would design a safety bib for pupils who walk to school. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Welcome visitors and help settle small quarrels
   Village elders help the village.

2. D — Walk away and calm down
   Cooling down prevents harm.

3. C — Lamu Cultural Festival
   The Lamu Cultural Festival celebrates coastal culture.

4. A — They can be moved when the family moves
   Portable houses suit families who move with their animals.

5. C — Crops need the right weather to grow and be harvested
   Planting and harvesting depend on rain and dry weather.

6. C — Keep customs and settle disputes
   Clan elders guard customs and settle quarrels.

7. D — North
   Facing east, north is on the left and south is on the right.

8. B — Electing a class monitor by voting
   Voting gives everyone a say.

9. B — In the east
   The sun rises in the east and sets in the west.

10. D — Farming
   Farming is growing crops and keeping livestock.

11. C — Fear and lost education
   Abuse harms the child's life.

12. C — From the national government and local fees and taxes
   Counties get shared money and collect local fees.

13. A — The direction of north
   A north arrow shows which way is north so the map can be read correctly.

14. D — Voting for leaders
   Voting is part of participating.

15. C — A plan of work with a start, a finish and a goal
   A project is planned work for a goal.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: North-east (between north and east), south-east (between south and east), south-west (between south and west), north-west (between north and west).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct in-between point with its place.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ksh 300.
   Working / marking points: Cost = 350 + 150 = 500. Profit = 800 - 500 = 300. 1 mark for cost, 1 mark for subtraction, 1 mark for answer.

18. (4 marks)
   Answer: Choose the quality, set a small goal, practise every day, and ask a friend to encourage you.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: Use bright cloth, cut it in a vest shape with a head opening, fix reflective strips across the front and back, and test that it is easy to wear and seen from far.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.
